discordPostHtml:
download link: https://github.com/Alaricdragon/Emergency_Escape/archive/refs/heads/master.zip

adds in a single hullmod that lets ships flee combat if destroyed (like the Phase Anchor)

comes with a lunasettings so you can change the max amount of ships this hullmod can 'escape' with. default is 1.

I made this because I was playing starsector with a single 'flagship' that I had to keep all game (for story reasons) and it can be really hard to get a capital ship to escape if you bite more then you can chew, and I got really really sick of reloading the game over and over. I wanna lose 40% of my fleet in peace please.

anyways, enjoy.
